title: Export through Show-rooms abroad / Duty free shops
text: 6.25 Export through Show-rooms abroad / Duty free shops Export of goods is also permitted for display / sale in permitted shops set up abroad or in showrooms of their distributors / agents. Items not sold abroad within 180 days shall be re- imported within 45 days.
